mechanism: Disulfiram inhibits CYP450 enzymes (particularly CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2D6, CYP3A4) which may increase ranitidine metabolism alterations and hepatic effects.
action: Monitor for increased ranitidine efficacy and potential accumulation; use ranitidine with caution in patients taking disulfiram, particularly those with hepatic impairment.
